set.descent_text: The straightforward descent reverses down to the Mary Green Glacier and follows the standard route's descent: down-climb the summit ridge/rock rib, use the fixed rappel stations through the class 3–4 band (about four rappels with a 60m rope, 8mm lines are common), cross the moat, and descend the glacier to Holden Pass camp — see the Mary Green Glacier route's descent notes for full detail on that shared lower section. Parties combining this face with a full three-summit traverse instead descend from the Southwest Peak via ledges onto the Isella Glacier's upper snowfields, traverse to the Southeast (Holden) Ridge, climb a short ~5.7 chimney, and then make a single rappel from the col back down onto the Mary Green Glacier before rejoining the standard glacier descent to camp. Either way, expect loose rock on the upper buttress and ridge sections and take care with rope management around the gendarmes and notches.
